caption: The drawing features three views of a single round button rendered on a beige background. The button is depicted in grayish-blue tones with shading to suggest a metallic or reflective surface. The top view is placed near the top center and shows the front of the button engraved with an ornate "H" in black script. Below and slightly to the left, the reverse side of the button is visible, focusing on a small loop or shank at the center. To the right, the button is portrayed in profile, showing its thin, oval edge and the protruding loop for attachment. The artist's name, "John. H. Tercuzzi.", is written in gray pencil at the lower left corner of the image. There are no other objects or details present except for a small, irregular brownish stain in the upper right corner.
title: Jewelry Button
